Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: pick up and haul
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Haulers pick up to six nearby items into their inventory in one trip and drop each one at its storage.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: put it there
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Right-click an item with a colonist selected, then click a cell, and the item is carried to that exact spot.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: instant caravan when safe
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: When no enemy threatens the map, a button in the caravan window forms and sends the caravan at once.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: haul on the way
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Colonists carry nearby items toward storage on their way to more kinds of work: crafting, building, research, cleaning, farming, mining and repairs. Needs a restart.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: mood colors
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: The mood word turns red near a break, yellow when low and green when happy.
